title: Choose the visual world for urelimitless.com
question: The roll assigned the Work Order Pad. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Work Order Pad
options.lineage: carbon-copy triplicate job tickets and work-order books
options.thesis: Every engagement is a work order: the visitor sees one being filled, assigned and stamped before they scroll.
options.viewport: A white original sheet fills the frame, yellow and pink copies fanned beneath. The headline is stamped in heavy condensed caps; below it a work order types itself in (Requested by, Need, Assigned), then ASSIGNED slams on in red. The primary action is the next blank ticket: Open a work order.
options.risk: Reads as a novelty form if the type is set small or the copies become decoration; the pad must carry the whole page, including projects as delivered tickets.

raised.raise: One trajectory: every order travels the same path, request to assignment to delivered, and the scroll follows that path sheet by sheet.
Controls with real travel: the stamp presses in, tabs tear on a perforation, buttons depress into the sheet.
Attention as luminance: only the line being typed is full ink; the rest of the form sits at carbon strength until it is reached.
Ground commitment: the yellow and pink copies own whole sections at page scale, never a tint on white.
One rail: every element registers to the red margin rule; nothing floats off it.
One continuous document: the page is a single pad, no section containers, place is which sheet you are on.

options.label: The Switchboard
options.lineage: telephone exchange patch bays and operator cord boards
options.thesis: The agency is the operator: companies on the left, tools and people on the right, and braided cords patch them through.
options.viewport: Dark board, a heavy headline left, and a live patch bay right where cords draw themselves from a company jack to a tool jack to a person jack. Primary action: Patch us in.
options.risk: The most literal reading of connect-companies-to-tools, and a dark board with glowing cords is close to where most AI agency sites already live.

options.label: Pulp Rocketship Plate
options.thesis: The agency as a finned rocket crossing a red sky on a diagonal.
options.viewport: A rocket on a diagonal with the brand lettered in streamlined caps.
options.case: Company leads do not identify with pulp sci-fi, and speed lines explain nothing about matching tools to people.
options.kept: One trajectory: a single path everything travels.
options.risk: Nostalgia costume with no product mechanism in it.

options.label: CD-ROM Console
options.thesis: A rendered machine with a postcard video window and toggles that depress.
options.viewport: A fixed console around a small video window; nothing scrolls.
options.case: The console cannot hold a persuasive reading order or a projects list, and the audience reads it as a game, not an agency.
options.risk: Retro novelty with no room for copy.

options.label: Luminescent Understory
options.lineage: surreal alien forest floor at night
options.thesis: Paths light themselves two steps ahead of the visitor.
options.viewport: A dark glowing field with labels blooming beside growths.
options.case: Beautiful but it says nothing a business lead can repeat: no tools, no people, no delivery.
options.kept: Attention as luminance: only the focused line is full ink.
options.risk: Dark-with-neon-glow is the AI category default in different clothes.

options.label: Accretion Disk
options.thesis: Matter crossing an irreversible threshold around an unmarked black centre.
options.viewport: A warped glowing disk with labels bent along ring bands.
options.case: An irreversible threshold is the wrong promise for an agency; the audience sees a physics demo.
options.kept: Total commitment of the ground colour at page scale.

options.label: Emission-Line Rail
options.lineage: glass spectrograms on a viewing box
options.thesis: Everything registers against one off-centre rail; state is line form, not hue.
options.viewport: A grey continuum crossed by needle-thin bright lines.
options.case: An Operate world; it carries dashboards well and a persuasive offer poorly, and the audience does not know spectrograms.
options.kept: One rail every element registers to.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.lineage: green-phosphor terminals in a machine room
options.thesis: One continuous transcript where the cursor breathes.
options.case: The terminal is the tool the AI crowd operates, which makes it the category costume; business leads do not read 80-column transcripts.
options.kept: One continuous document, no section containers.
options.risk: Reads as a developer tool, not an agency.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The AI agency page every competitor ships, executed impeccably: dark navy, gradient headline, bento features, logo row.
canonCard.viewport: Centred headline over subcopy and two buttons, a logo row, four feature cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
